definition: humble submission and respect
example: He spoke with deference to the elder statesman.

definition: showing a great deal of variety
example: The region hosts a diverse array of wildlife.

definition: temporarily inactive or in a state of rest
example: The seed lay dormant through the winter.

definition: deceitfulness; double-dealing
example: He was sick of the duplicity around him.

definition: a poem of serious reflection, typically a lament for the dead
example: She read a moving elegy at the memorial.

definition: to match or surpass a person or achievement
example: Young chefs tried to emulate her signature dish.

definition: a state or feeling of active opposition or hostility
example: Years of enmity ended with the handshake.

definition: open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous
example: His equivocal answer left reporters guessing.

definition: former; belonging to an earlier time
example: He met his erstwhile rival at the conference.

definition: to deliberately avoid using or indulging in
example: She eschewed sugar for the entire month.

definition: a speech in praise of someone, typically the deceased
example: He delivered a heartfelt eulogy.

definition: to indicate or make evident
example: His smile evinced his relief.

definition: a person or thing serving as a typical example
example: She was the exemplar of perseverance.

definition: a person or organization that is new and inexperienced
example: The fledgling startup struggled for capital.

definition: happening by chance, especially a fortunate chance
example: A fortuitous meeting changed the course of her career.

definition: irritable and quarrelsome
example: The fractious committee refused to vote.

definition: impressive and large in scale or ambition
example: Their grandiose plans collapsed on contact with reality.

definition: assuming power or authority without justification; domineering
example: Her imperious manner alienated the staff.

definition: impossible to subdue or defeat
example: Her indomitable spirit inspired us all.

definition: too great or extreme to be expressed in words
example: She felt ineffable joy at the news.

definition: showing or feeling hesitancy; uncertain
example: The irresolute captain lost the crew confidence.

definition: a tedious recital or repetitive series
example: A litany of complaints filled the inbox.

definition: an unorthodox or independent-minded person
example: The maverick senator broke party ranks.

definition: to exclude from a society or group
example: The village ostracized him after the scandal.

definition: excessively concerned with minor details or rules
example: His pedantic corrections annoyed the editors.
